scientific_integrity: Claims derive from an analytic four-replica trace, strict inequalities and Steiner-system rigidity; finite exact checks are reproducibility support, not an infinite-domain proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to Haar-random pure states of seven parties of equal local integer dimension \(p\ge2\) and exactly seven distinct size-three supports; the known pair covariance formula and Fano incidence facts are credited. An earlier implicit specialization is possible; no independent expert validation.
title: The Fano plane uniquely minimizes seven-cut Haar purity variance
